name: Our Telekom main Data Centre room / Exchange Building (Honiara)
notes: Operator article (23 Oct 2017) confirms Our Telekom's Exchange Building in Honiara houses the main Data Centre room (first floor) containing the core systems of Solomon Telekom's national telecommunications network, plus the Network Operations Center (NOC); data hosting systems are also operated at the Kaibia technical complex with UPS/earth-station rooms. Per SB methodology this is the incumbent telco hosting node (ISOC Pulse counts 1 active DC nationally). Public colocation product and current capacity not confirmed.

name: SATSOL Honiara data centre (directory claim)
notes: DataCenterMap directory lists a Honiara data center for SATSOL Limited (local ISP/digital TV/Starlink reseller) with backup/cooling/security claims. No primary SATSOL facility page or strong secondary source found; kept as an unverified C-grade lead per SB methodology (do not count as confirmed facility).

name: Noro Data Centre (Noro Fisheries MCS / Provincial Data Centre)
developer: Government of Solomon Islands (Western Provincial Government / FFA fisheries MCS; funded by World Bank/FFA/Australia)
notes: Prime Minister handed over the Noro Fisheries MCS Building and Provincial Data Centre in Noro, Western Province, 10-13 Nov 2025 (World Bank/FFA/Australia funded; contractors Reeves International and TCS International; Australia contributed AUD 1.3 million). Island Sun (12 Nov 2025) describes a government backup/DR role for critical records should Honiara be hit by major disasters. A-grade for announcement/location; operations and capacity details pending per SB methodology.
